payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP with state (i, j) where i is current index in S (processed from end to start) and j is length of T's prefix matched by A so far; transitions based on adding s[i] to front or back.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 2D array dp[i][j] with i over positions in S and j over matched prefix length of T, updating iteratively. This is a classic 2D DP structure, not memoized recursion or 1D.
